name: x86-64 ELF Loader
description: Implemented a userspace x86-64 ELF64 binary loader in C that parses program headers, manages mmap memory mappings, initializes zero-byte .bss segments, and sets up the program stack.

name: bangScript
description: Developed a custom stack-based bytecode virtual machine and language compiler from scratch, exploring low-level runtime execution, opcode evaluation, and language design.

name: Distributed Map Reduce
description: Implemented the Google MapReduce distributed computing paper from scratch, featuring fault-tolerant worker coordination and RPC task scheduling.

name: bitty
description: Engineered a concurrent BitTorrent client implementing peer wire protocols and piece block downloading.

name: YMAI (Yet Another Malloc Implementation)
description: Engineered a general-purpose memory allocator with double-linked free list management, first-fit placement, and heap block coalescing
